import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

orcids = [
    '0000-0001-6102-7846',
    '0000-0002-0209-2784',
    '0000-0002-1053-2030',
    '0000-0002-2605-6569',
    '0000-0003-0396-0333'
]

def count_pre2020_from_html(orcid):
    url = f'https://orcid.org/{orcid}'
    r = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(r.text, 'html.parser')
    text = soup.get_text('\n')
    # Heuristic: find year-like patterns and treat each as a work entry if < 2020
    years = re.findall(r'(19\d{2}|20\d{2})', text)
    count = sum(1 for y in years if y.isdigit() and int(y) < 2020)
    return count

results = {}
for oid in orcids:
    try:
        results[oid] = count_pre2020_from_html(oid)
    except Exception as e:
        results[oid] = 0

print('Pre-2020 heuristic counts:')
print(results)
